guardrails.title: Guardrails
guardrails.subtitle: Global rules, test fixtures and prompt core applied to every AI assistant

rules.title: Global rules
rules.desc: Every rule is an editable row — none of them are hardcoded.

fixtures.title: Fixtures
fixtures.desc: Test scenarios replayed against every assistant (read-only for now).

core.title: Prompt core (L0)
core.desc: Shared body injected into every assistant's compiled prompt.

reset.confirmBody: “{label}” will revert to its default configuration. This happens immediately.

resetAll.confirmBody: Every default rule and fixture will revert to its original configuration, and any that were deleted will be recreated. Custom rules and fixtures are not affected.

guardrails.emptyCore: No prompt core — run the seed
guardrails.helpCost: Costs one model call per draft.
guardrails.ruleDialogHint: The kind decides what is analysed; the severity decides what happens when the rule fails.
guardrails.keyImmutable: The key does not change: it identifies the rule in traces and overrides.
guardrails.kindImmutable: The kind cannot change after creation — the config shape depends on it.
guardrails.promptTextPlaceholder: What the assistant should read in its prompt (optional)
guardrails.promptTextHint: Added to the guardrail layer of the compiled prompt. Empty = runtime-only rule.

deleteConfirm.title: Delete “{label}”?
deleteConfirm.body: This rule will no longer apply. “Reset all” will recreate it if it came from the seed — a hand-written rule, no.

config.criterionPlaceholder: The reply states no fact that is not in the allowed claims.
config.nothingToConfigure: Nothing to configure: this rule only adds its text to the prompt.

errors.invalidConfig: The configuration is invalid for this kind of rule.
errors.customCannotBlock: A “prompt instruction” analyses nothing: marked blocking, it shows as a hard guardrail while it can refuse nothing. To guarantee behaviour, use “Model judgement”.

list.title: AI assistants
list.subtitle: Every assistant is fully editable: goal, tone, tools, guardrails and prompt.

empty.title: No assistants
empty.desc: Create an assistant or import one from a JSON file.

deleteConfirm.title: Delete “{name}”?
deleteConfirm.body: This assistant has never sent a message: it will be permanently deleted.
deleteConfirm.bodyArchive: This assistant has already sent messages. It will be archived, not deleted — conversations must stay readable alongside the assistant that wrote them.

editor.unsavedLeave: You have unsaved changes. Leaving this page will discard them.

stale.title: Stale prompt
stale.body: The configuration changed since the last compile. Settings re-read every turn (tools, model, budgets) already apply; the prompt TEXT is still the one from the last compile.
stale.bodyActive: This assistant is active. Settings re-read every turn already apply to ongoing conversations; the prompt text is still the older one. Recompile to align them.

effects.immediate: {count, plural, one {# setting applies} other {# settings apply}} from the next message
effects.pending: {count, plural, one {# setting is waiting} other {# settings are waiting}} for a recompile

goal.chainNote: A SOFT refusal steps down one rung. A hard refusal never touches the chain: the conversation closes.
goal.noFallbacks: No fallbacks — a postponement ends the follow-up.
goal.whatToObtain: What the assistant is trying to obtain
goal.calendarHint: Decides which CRM appointment type is checked for availability.

knowledge.placeholder: A verifiable fact the assistant may state
knowledge.empty: No allowed claims: the assistant may not state any business information.
knowledge.warning: Anything listed here will be stated in writing on behalf of a licensed broker.

tools.requiredNote: “stop” and “handoff” cannot be disabled: they are how a refusal is honoured and a human is brought in.

guardrails.coreNote: Shared by every assistant. Edit them under Guardrails; here they can only be overridden for this assistant.
guardrails.ownEmpty: No specific rules — the core rules apply alone.

model.toolWarning: This model does not support tools: the assistant will not be able to check the calendar or book.
model.routingNote: These values apply to the router only; direct providers ignore them.

prompt.notCompiled: Not compiled yet — run a compile to see the prompt.
prompt.rawWarning: In free mode the tabs no longer write the prompt. The configuration still drives runtime behaviour.

errors.staleCompile: The prompt must be recompiled before activation.
errors.suiteNotPassed: The guardrail suite must be green before activation.

identity.namedPersonWarning: The assistant writes on behalf of a person but no account is attached: meetings will fall back to an administrator.
identity.freeTextHint: No account linked: meetings will fall back to an administrator.
identity.linkedHint: The name follows the chosen account; meetings are assigned to them.

import.title: Import an assistant
import.bindingsNote: The file comes from another installation: its ids point at nobody here. Pick the local equivalent for each reference.
import.invalid: This file is not a valid assistant export.

goalTypeHint.video_meeting: Books a video call in the calendar.
goalTypeHint.in_person_meeting: Books a meeting at the office or the client's place.
goalTypeHint.phone_call: Books a call slot in the calendar.
goalTypeHint.collect_email: Books nothing: only tries to get an email address.
goalTypeHint.collect_callback_time: Books nothing: agrees on a time to call back.
goalTypeHint.qualify_only: NEVER proposes a meeting — only gathers information.
goalTypeHint.handoff: Books nothing: aims to hand the conversation to a human.
